colors.note: Original deployed Ledger palette restored per user review.

typography.note: Font imports restored after silent regression.

motion.rules: opacity/transform only, one-shot reveals at 18% visibility, count-up once, no loops/parallax/glow/network graphics

patterns: Full-viewport hero with constellation field and live UTC stamp
Oversized outlined chapter numerals per section
Sticky section intros on desktop grids

must: Preserve all approved factual copy, routes, metadata, schema and evidence limitations verbatim
No em or en dashes anywhere in visible copy or titles (AI-tell ban)
Tight page-hero spacing: no large voids above headings
WCAG AA contrast, keyboard-complete interactions, visible focus
GTM loads only on the production host with a runtime hostname guard
avoid: Generic SaaS card grids, stock imagery, fabricated metrics or clients
More than one marquee per page
Large animation or 3D libraries (vanilla CSS/JS only)

decisions.reason: The experimental build intentionally replaces the production Ledger design. Dark canvas, Space Grotesk display type, mint signal accent and chapter-based scroll storytelling differentiate it completely while keeping every factual claim intact.

decisions.choice: Remove the AI-search visibility map; rebuild the measurement spine
decisions.reason: The old light-green diagrams clashed with the dark theme. The first was removed entirely per feedback; the measurement path was rebuilt as a staged dark SVG with replay and reduced-motion support.

All hero network motion is one-shot (links draw once, four nodes illuminate in sequence, then rest). Folio numerals reduced to quiet mono marks and hidden below 720px. Sticky header is solid rgba with a thin rule instead of blur glass. Accordions are exclusive with grid-rows height animation and plus-to-minus. Type scale locked to the 72-88/56-72/38-52/20-28/17-20/11-13px spec with fluid clamps.

decisions.choice: BASIC/DEPT-inspired re-theme: flat black, pink accent, film grain
decisions.reason: User direction: adopt basicagency.com style foundations (black surface, #f4f4f4 text, #f9cdcd accent, 18px base, pill controls, noise texture, flat composition). All gradients and glows removed; boxed measurement diagram replaced by a flat typographic spine strip; header made permanently solid to eliminate content bleed-through. No content changed; proprietary SctoGroteskA font and assets not copied.

decisions.choice: Reverted BASIC pink re-theme back to mint Signal Atlas
decisions.reason: User review: the black-and-pink direction looked bad; the earlier mint-on-navy theme was preferred. Palette, glows, radii and type scale restored to the pre-BASIC state. The BASIC pass improvements that were kept: permanently solid header (fixes content bleed-through) and the flat typographic measurement spine (boxed diagram removed). Education Note row removed from the about page founder facts per user instruction; structured data still records alumniOf: NIT Surat.

decisions.choice: Restore deployed Ledger theme; keep and refine the motion layer
decisions.reason: User direction: the deployed Ledger visual direction (warm paper, ink serif, measurement green, print-like borders) is correct; the experimental build now matches it and adds only purposeful motion: hero line/panel sequence, one-shot count-up, ledger row reveals, sliding nav underline, decision-board tab transitions, hover micro-interactions, scroll progress line. Framer Motion/GSAP not added (static Astro site; vanilla JS meets every requirement). Banned per spec: network graphics (SignalField removed), looping ticker (removed), live UTC clock (replaced with static scope language).

User direction: near-black sections felt disconnected and dim. All section--ink backgrounds now use deep green #0C4F3D (cards/table bands #105A46), warm-white serif headings, soft-green body text #D7E4DC, mint labels #63D6AE, white-alpha rules. Cream remains dominant; CTA band matches #0C4F3D. scroll-margin-top 112px added for anchor navigation.

decisions.choice: Dedicated /services page with six outcome-based categories
decisions.reason: User correction: lifecycle stages are engagement stages, not services. Services index now lists six buyable categories (Growth Strategy & Measurement; Search, SEO & AI Visibility; Paid Acquisition & Performance; Conversion & Lifecycle Growth; AI Agent Development; AI & GPT Integrations) as numbered ledger rows with alternating cream/pale-tint backgrounds. The five lifecycle stages moved to a deep-green engagement-path section. Every CTA links to /contact/?service=[slug]#request-a-brief (trailing slash required by trailingSlash:always); the contact form reads the param, prefills a visible editable dropdown + hidden selected_service field, and shows Selected service: [name]. Homepage credibility band removed. Nav now: Services, Methodology, Work, Insights, About.

decisions.choice: Concise homepage with detail routed to deeper pages
alternatives: Keep every scope detail on the homepage
Compress the capability explorer on mobile
decisions.reason: The homepage now prioritizes proposition, method, free tools, selected insights, process, founder trust, FAQs and conversion. The dense capability explorer and evidence board were removed from the homepage, while detailed scope remains on service and methodology pages. Supporting summaries and repeated qualifiers were reduced so mobile visitors can scan the page without navigating a compressed desktop tab interface.
